business_problem: PGP Glass lacked reliable visibility into operational technology and IoT devices across its factories. Unseen assets and uncertain endpoint protection created cybersecurity exposure, while energy optimization models also depended on continuous, trustworthy operations data.
solution_summary: PGP Glass deployed Armis from ServiceNow across manufacturing plants in India and Sri Lanka to discover and secure connected IT, OT, and IoT assets. Data from more than 10,000 sensors, programmable logic controllers, scanners, gateways, and other operational sources flows into Armis, which supplies asset visibility and device context to security tools and the company's Unified Energy Monitoring System and Real-Time Manufacturing Intelligence system. Reliable asset and operating data supports the existing AI/ML models used to improve energy efficiency and reduce manufacturing waste. Armis also helps identify vulnerabilities and manage asset configurations; planned SIEM automation was still in progress at the time of the story. The source does not name the energy models or underlying cloud infrastructure.
